meta.title: Reopen when no line has expired

plan.title: Reopen Line Items Disabled Before Expiry

steps.note: Open the prepared live staggered event before any line has expired.
Open the event Settings menu containing Reopen Line Items.
Assert that Reopen Line Items is present but disabled and has a reason tooltip.
Reopen the Settings menu so the disabled menu item can be hovered for the exact tooltip.
Reveal the disabled item's explanatory tooltip.

args.text: Line items can only be reopened if at least one line item has expired

steps.note: Verify the required reason shown to the buyer.
